title: Do automated date and citation checks improve 4B and 12B single-model answers?
summary: Twelve questions focused on timing and chart grounding, comparing three answer paths on Google's Gemma 4B and 12B models: a plain single-pass answer, an answer with deterministic date checking, and a fully checked profile with model review.
takeaway: Automated date checking fixed the 4B model's past-appointment mistake, and the fully checked 4B profile scored highest overall while attaching verified source records. However, two strict six-month date-window questions still slipped through, showing where date filtering needed to be tightened.
